story.text: This is the working site of the **VPK pathway lane** — a system for handing someone a *slice* of a private knowledge base over a tailnet, at a fidelity they have earned, and being able to say afterwards exactly what crossed.
It is written here because a federated wiki is what it governs. Every page is forkable, and a fork is how you disagree with it.
[[Virtual Private Knowledge]] — the idea, in one page.
[[The Pathway]] — the primitive everything else is built from.
[[The Disclosure Ladder]] — D0 to D4: how much of a thing crosses a wire.
[[The Grant]] — a pathway becomes a served, scoped, expiring knowledge base.
[[The Runtime]] — the same grant read back as a trust task.
[[The Compression]] — how few words carry this to the next network.
[[Point And Shoot]] — the whole loop in one move, with the keeper still in it.
[[An Example Pathway]] — a real one, measured end to end.
Not a proof of understanding. Not a cryptographic guarantee. Not a claim about anyone else’s network. Each page says its own limits; see [[What This Does Not Prove]].
